P1 Pillar A for alembic_plan draft pure collection. After accepted P0 clean slate, make alembic_plan draft return faithful full project facts: full untrimmed ProjectContext presenterInput/facts and full mission-briefing facts, not counts-only summaries or speculative wrappers. Gate on raw draft payload quality for a real project shape: an Agent reading only Pillar A can describe what the project is. No dimension relevance/scale/subset/recommendation/top judgment, no payload compression that hides facts, and no P2 SOP/catalog work except preserving compatibility for later assembly.

P2 Core producer for Pillar B. Expose/support the full dimension catalog and complete per-dimension SOP payload for draft assembly, plus a thin factual languageApplicable matcher based only on project language/framework facts. Preserve all 25 dimensions and SOP details; do not rank, filter, select, force foundational dimensions, estimate scale, or reintroduce domain-signal/complexity judgment. This produces Core primitives/exports/tests for Plugin P2 assembly.

P2 Plugin assembly for alembic_plan draft pure collection. After accepted P1 Plugin project facts and accepted P2 Core catalog/SOP primitives, wire AlembicPlugin draft to return Pillar B in the raw draft payload: full dimension catalog (all 25, universal+language+framework), complete per-dimension SOP plus analysisGuide/submissionSpec, and transparent factual languageApplicable/languageApplicability tags derived only from project languages/frameworks. All dimensions must remain present; draft must not rank, recommend, top, filter, subset, force foundational, estimate scale, or silently drop dimensions. Preserve P1 full project facts and existing draft/confirm/get semantics; do not implement P3 confirm full-catalog in this package except preserving compatibility. Avoid exposing or using old registry weight as priority/ranking semantics in the draft-facing payload. Evidence required: commit hash, raw BiliDili draft payload summary showing 25 dimensions, non-empty SOP steps for every dimension, factual language tags (universal true; Swift/project framework matches only by facts), no active/skip/rank/score/scale/recommend/top/subset fields, targeted tests/build/biome/git diff check, and residue scans.

P3 Plugin Plan closed loop for alembic-plan-draft-pure-collection. With P1 project facts and P2 full dimension catalog accepted, fix and verify alembic_plan confirm so an Agent can select any dimension from the full 25-dimension catalog, including language/framework dimensions such as swift-objc-idiom/react-patterns/swiftui-patterns, not only base/universal dimensions. Confirmed Plan must persist, get must round-trip the selected dimensions/modules/scale/actions/evidence, and cold-start must consume the confirmed Plan as its precondition through the existing no-guess path. This package must not add draft relevance judgment, recommendation/top/subset, active/skip, ranking/scoring, scale estimation, fallback selection, or P4 Test acceptance logic.

P4 real-project end-to-end acceptance for alembic-plan-draft-pure-collection. With P0/P1/P2/P3 accepted, Test must prove on real BiliDili that the chain works as the requirement defines: new alembic_plan draft returns raw project facts and the full dimension/SOP catalog; an Agent authors a complete, project-fit Plan using only that raw draft payload (dimension choices, scale, module bindings, next actions, evidence/rationale); confirm persists it; get round-trips it; cold-start consumes the confirmed Plan as the no-guess precondition. The outcome must be a valuable, non-empty, project-fit Plan and cold-start evidence. Optional low-cost non-Swift project coverage may be added, but BiliDili is the required gate. Test must not modify product code or invent recommendation/top/rank/filter/scale-estimation behavior.
